mentions.name: Lunova
mentions.description: This app connects to QuickBooks Online and lets users create custom alerts delivered via SMS or email, such as when large deposits land, invoices go overdue, or vendor prices spike. It passed Intuit's tech/security and marketing review and is live on the QuickBooks Online App Store.
